audited_commit_note: contest-time HEAD (2025-08-31); later commits only add a Discord export
notes: No fixed version is public: the judge can only check that a test shows the harm on the contest commit; matching to this list is by reading.
Findings are numbered across both components as in the report: H-01, H-02, M-01..M-15 are Perps; H-03..H-10, M-16..M-25 are Launchpad.
M-22 has a different heading format in the report and was added separately; its file list comes from the file names in its section, like the others.
